correctness.rationale: For integer partitions into strictly positive species abundances at fixed N,S, reconstructed hypergeometric R_m=Σ[1-C(N−n_i,m)/C(N,m)]. Independent exact Fraction enumeration of every same-richness unordered partition pair, all N=2..10 and interior m, found no strict sign reversal for N≤9 and one pair for N=10: (6,2,2) versus (5,4,1), S=3. Verified R2=73/45<74/45, R3=61/30<41/20, R4=163/70>242/105; the full m=2..9 signs reverse between m=3,4. R2=2−Σ n_i(n_i−1)/(N(N−1)); R_{N−1}=S−f1/N. Completeness relies on enumerating all integer partitions, not numerical sampling or unchecked logs.
